observations.title: Chat template looks like a template-injection payload
observations.description: The model's Jinja chat template reaches Python internals (dunder attributes, os/subprocess, eval). Some runtimes render templates in an unsandboxed environment, which turns this into code execution (CVE-2024-34359 class).

relevant-evidence.description: path gguf/ssti.gguf; sha256 f2449fc4730c93e3272d2b654d1801db17995c030c35ef7d8bee1508a4f63687; tokenizer.chat_template: __init__

observations.remarks: Fix: Replace the chat template with a reviewed one and render templates in a sandboxed Jinja environment.

observations.title: Model file format can't be scanned yet
observations.description: This file is a format that can run code on load, but Gapproof can't parse this variant yet, so it can't be shown safe.

relevant-evidence.description: path gguf/v1.gguf; sha256 43a802114c8fd4da5e98545781edb9330c2203bdd506863ac9c1f55f64864595; gguf: unsupported version 1

observations.remarks: Fix: Convert to safetensors or GGUF, or document the file as an accepted risk.

observations.title: Model config requires remote code
observations.description: The Hugging Face config declares auto_map, so loading it with trust_remote_code=True imports and runs Python modules shipped with the model.

relevant-evidence.description: path hf/remote_code/config.json; sha256 cce528b39e77fe07a4346e4c5d50e1e1c8b8d25cfed9419c57d2095ac323b2b4; auto_map AutoModel=modeling_custom.CustomModel

observations.remarks: Fix: Vendor the model code into your own source tree, remove auto_map, and load with trust_remote_code=False.

observations.title: Chat template looks like a template-injection payload
observations.description: The model's Jinja chat template reaches Python internals (dunder attributes, os/subprocess, eval). Some runtimes render templates in an unsandboxed environment, which turns this into code execution (CVE-2024-34359 class).

relevant-evidence.description: path hf/remote_code/tokenizer_config.json; sha256 ca85a8f0bfa128c00a59fe7e5377aff44d9bcebef6b04a1afad880852b420b36; chat_template: __class__

observations.remarks: Fix: Replace the chat template with a reviewed one and render templates in a sandboxed Jinja environment.

observations.title: Keras model contains a Lambda layer
observations.description: Lambda layers store serialized Python bytecode that runs when the model is loaded (CVE-2024-3660 class).

relevant-evidence.description: path keras/lambda.h5; offset 2009; sha256 0ad3dc08f75b7faec1771c7dbef8eec2f6be57a7426b0baa5aba6565d4c27d53; class_name Lambda in model_config

observations.remarks: Fix: Replace Lambda layers with registered custom layers defined in your source code, and load with safe_mode=True.

observations.title: Keras model contains a Lambda layer
observations.description: Lambda layers store serialized Python bytecode that runs when the model is loaded (CVE-2024-3660 class).

relevant-evidence.description: path keras/lambda.keras; member config.json; sha256 f6aa73274315cdb50a77cf9305d09666e86538bba0f2f01e443c2cf1b61f541a; class_name Lambda

observations.remarks: Fix: Replace Lambda layers with registered custom layers defined in your source code, and load with safe_mode=True.

observations.title: Keras config references a non-Keras module
observations.description: The model config asks the loader to import objects from a module outside Keras. Config-driven imports have been used to bypass safe_mode (CVE-2025-1550 class).

relevant-evidence.description: path keras/module_bypass.keras; member config.json; sha256 197d60e773c76b28d065878e8ca61960014a1554d4af6315aa9cf2380e30278c; module builtins

observations.remarks: Fix: Rebuild the model so its config only references Keras objects and your own registered classes.

observations.title: NumPy array stores Python objects
observations.description: An object-dtype .npy needs np.load(allow_pickle=True), which unpickles its payload. Any imports in that payload are reported separately.

relevant-evidence.description: path numpy/object.npy; offset 128; sha256 6c66629a9c906250989620952d5af232a09acf12ccd5d80865c4231735757a42; dtype object: payload is a pickle

props.name: detail
props.value: dtype object: payload is a pickle

observations.remarks: Fix: Store numeric arrays only (no object dtype), or move the data to safetensors.

observations.title: Model file runs code when loaded
observations.description: Loading this pickle (pickle.load, joblib.load, or torch.load with weights_only=False) imports a code-execution primitive. Anyone who can change this file can run arbitrary code on the host that loads it.

relevant-evidence.description: path numpy/object.npy; offset 149; sha256 6c66629a9c906250989620952d5af232a09acf12ccd5d80865c4231735757a42; STACK_GLOBAL builtins.print

observations.remarks: Fix: Convert the weights to safetensors (or GGUF) and ship only that file. Don't load this file anywhere until it is replaced.

observations.title: ONNX model reads data from outside its directory
observations.description: An ONNX tensor's external_data location is absolute or climbs out of the model directory, so loading the model reads an arbitrary file from the host.

relevant-evidence.description: path onnx/escape.onnx; sha256 d805ae769cb55e655fbebf6b056095ac7f08d0bfdb75aa86b6cc296a0abce44f; tensor "w2" location=../../../etc/shadow

observations.remarks: Fix: Re-export the model with external data stored beside it (relative paths only).

observations.title: Model file could not be verified
observations.description: Gapproof couldn't fully parse this model file (corrupt, truncated, over a safety limit, or deliberately malformed). It fails closed: an unverifiable model file is a finding, not a skip.

relevant-evidence.description: path onnx/garbage.onnx; sha256 b4fabc7e6e75fa4b523cc55f51aa54ab1aa4309c92cc44fcf623ddef756f5391; protobuf: unsupported wire type 7

observations.remarks: Fix: Re-export the file with its framework's serializer and rescan. If the file is legitimately unusual, document it as an accepted risk.

observations.title: ONNX external data file is missing
observations.description: The model references an external data file that isn't in the scanned filesystem, so its weights aren't accounted for in the AI-BOM.

relevant-evidence.description: path onnx/missing.onnx; sha256 3eb03d774e8e7bac07ada1689374b20a418483e315b56b8c2ff0ab1401438d15; tensor "w" location=not_shipped.data

observations.remarks: Fix: Ship the external data file in the image, or point --models at its location.

observations.title: Model archive is structurally suspicious
observations.description: The archive has properties that make different readers see different content (for example duplicate member names). Scanners and loaders may disagree about what is inside.

relevant-evidence.description: path pickle/duplicate_member.pt; member archive/data.pkl; sha256 974479314af1a0af03fdaafe095b1f60ea3b4e92c61a5e4eb732ddd2d850d101; duplicate zip member name

observations.remarks: Fix: Re-save the model with the framework's own serializer and rescan.

observations.title: Model file runs code when loaded

relevant-evidence.description: path pickle/duplicate_member.pt; member archive/data.pkl; offset 21; sha256 974479314af1a0af03fdaafe095b1f60ea3b4e92c61a5e4eb732ddd2d850d101; STACK_GLOBAL builtins.print

observations.remarks: Fix: Convert the weights to safetensors (or GGUF) and ship only that file. Don't load this file anywhere until it is replaced.

observations.title: Model file hides what it imports
observations.description: This pickle builds an import from values Gapproof can't resolve statically (computed STACK_GLOBAL operands or the copyreg extension registry). Legitimate serializers don't do this; obfuscated payloads do.

relevant-evidence.description: path pickle/ext_registry.pkl; offset 2; sha256 c595bc8497a523c324585ada0204e2c53f192d8ef4af8d56fc761d13bd7b88d8; EXT1 with non-static operands

observations.remarks: Fix: Treat the file as hostile and replace it with a safetensors export from a trusted source.
